description: This file defines a Java interface 'PolicyCommandAdapterProvider' which extends multiple other provider interfaces related to policy command handling, including query, modify, and error response adapters for policy-related signals. It primarily sets up a contract for implementing classes to handle various policy command types in a standardized manner.

classes.name: PolicyCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: A Java interface that serves as a provider for all policy command adapters, extending multiple specific provider interfaces for query, modify, and error response handling.
